title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade countertop organization with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass and designed with a weighted base to help prevent tipping. Ideal for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories looks where clean lines and functional, minimalist styling matter.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting for easy placement on a counter
- Solid brass construction for a substantial, crafted feel
- Weighted base helps prevent tipping during use
- Felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Overall size: 14-Inch H x 5-Inch W x 5-Inch L
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Material: Brass
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
